Nothing new on Torii and Tigers. Between us....seems like they have bigger holes to fill and needs to address at the moment.

On Nov 12, 2014 12:30 PM, "Fenech, Anthony" <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:
Hi Mike,
Just checking in again. Can you tell me if there have been talks between Hanrahan and the Tigers, as Buster Olney tweeted? https://twitter.com/Buster_ESPN/status/532607099348729856
If so, what stage are those talks in?
And have there been any talks between the Tigers and Torii Hunter? If not, about how many teams have expressed interest in him?
I will not use your name.
